notes.title: New demo tech version 1.6 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/dc03d94841ebbdf1c3615faa4cd740521a56ef8c.png[/img]

Small update fixing a few issues.

New Features and Fixes:
- Now when restart the level dont have to watch the long intro again.
- Better shadows in interiors levels.
- Now you can go back from the bank to the street again.

Planned Next Update:
- Fix sounds issues when interact with doors.
- Drop items and can pick then up again.
- More stuff in the map.
- More Map.
- More Interiors.
- Make a Game Manual with the inputs and how to play.
- More ways to interact with objects on the map.
- More ways to loot on the map.

Thank you all for trying the demo and for your reviews. I will improve the game and the demo with your advice. I will update the demo and the game every 2 weeks or so.

Sincerely Daniel Pintado Game Development

notes.title: New demo tech version 1.4 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/dc03d94841ebbdf1c3615faa4cd740521a56ef8c.png[/img]

This was a quick update, to fix bugs in the game. Sorry for the errors, but they should all be solved by now (I hope)

New Features and Fixes:
- Fixed some errors when looting close to doors.
- Fixed the loot zombies dont let you pick up more items when you still have space in the pockets.
- Now the zombies take more time to disappear.
- Now health items. Now you can survive longer.
- One more interior.
- Change some items locations. Now you need to explore to find them.
- More map interactions.

Planned Next Update:
- Add more interiors and map to the demo.
- More ways to interact with objects on the map.
- More ways to loot on the map.
- Make a game manual. Show the inputs and how to play the game.
-Close combat.

Thank you all for trying the demo and for your reviews. I will improve the game and the demo with your advice. I will update the demo and the game every 2 weeks or so.

Sincerely Daniel Pintado Game Development

notes.title: New demo tech version 1.1 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/dc03d94841ebbdf1c3615faa4cd740521a56ef8c.png[/img]

New Features
- Now I pause menu is in the game. Pres "Esc" or "Start" to open it.
- An improvement in image quality and graphics, making it easier to distinguish where things are.
- A redesign in some parts of the map giving it a more sinister and darker touch.
- Improved aiming accuracy
-Plus extra optimization in some assets

Thank you all for trying the demo and for your reviews. I will improve the game and the demo with your advice. 

Sincerely Daniel Pintado Game Development
